text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I couldn't do it... I lost!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I can't believe I thought I could<n>follow in Air
Groove's footsteps. I'm<n>not even at the point
where I can<n>chase after her yet...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I can't even get close to her, no<n>matter how hard I
try! She's just<n>getting farther and farther away!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I won't be able to accomplishanything at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I must become like Air Groove! I<n>can't build a new
legacy if I don't!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... I have to do something!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to race in the Takarazuka<n>Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober makes her declaration<n>the moment
she returns to the waiting<n>room, her expression
filled with<n>desperation.

This race made it clear... If I can't win<n>here, how
can I expect to win<n>anywhere else?

But this isn't the time to be getting<n>depressed. I'm
not the same person I<n>was after the Arima Kinen.
I'm going<n>to keep fighting this battle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No doubt Air Groove will be running in<n>the spring
Grand Prix—the Takarazuka<n>Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And if that's the case, then I'm<n>running in it too! I
have to face off<n>against her again!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have to figure out what's preventing<n>me from
becoming like her!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It's that feeling again...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That same strange sense of unease<n>I've
experienced before rattles loudly<n>in my chest.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
My lips part, and before I know it, a<n>question spills
forth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's no point asking her such a<n>thing when I
myself can't put what<n>I'm feeling into words yet.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I need to think this through and find<n>an answer...
Only then can I talk to<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...You're so weird.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In any case, our next goal is<n>decided—she'll be
running the<n>Takarazuka Kinen.
